items.expected_conclusion: Reduction makes buffer insertion less favorable for both H3BO3 and Tris, with a several-kcal/mol reduced-minus-oxidized shift; this supports state-dependent buffer coordination as a contributor to apparent PCET kinetic anisotropy.
